newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nycomed merger dominates Norwegian share trade.
newsitem.headline: Nycomed merger dominates Norwegian share trade.

text.p: Norwegian drugs group Nycomed ASA dominated share trading on the Oslo bourse on Tuesday after the company announced it would merge with Britain's Amersham International Plc.
The market reacted positively to the proposal and Nycomed's A share surged more than 20 percent to a high at 135 crowns, before edging back to close at 132.50, a rise of 24.50 crowns.

The company's B stock also advanced 24.50 crowns to close at 129.50 crowns after hitting an intraday peak at 130.50 crowns. Nycomed accounted for more than 800 million crowns of the day's turnover of 1.26 billion crowns.
"There are great synergies between product portfolios and on the sales and marketing sides. Nycomed can now become a global player in the life sciences business," a Swedish-based analyst said.
Shipping group Stolt Comex Seaway raced ahead 20 percent to 212 crowns after the company posted higher second-quarter results due to improved market conditions.
Oslo's Total share index traded to a new life high at the close at 1,205.28 points, a rise of 0.92 percent.
